svg.aria-label: A day with wsl-spawner. At sign-in, its sign-in program starts the distributions you chose. All day it keeps them running, where WSL would stop one that no Windows program uses. At sign-out, shutdown or an update's restart, Windows runs the sign-out scripts and wsl-spawner's runs last: it gives every service and container its time to stop, notes how the stop went, then stops WSL. At the next start, the containers come back and wsl-spawner knows how the last run ended. A crash, a Windows update of WSL or wsl --shutdown give no sign-out: the next start says the run ended without its time.
